lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A structured grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the pectoral fin. The spots are arranged in approximately four horizontal rows between the carinae, with a spatial frequency that increases toward the anterior region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, intersecting with the horizontal carinae to form a coordinate-like grid; circular blobs are localized precisely at these vertical-horizontal nodal points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features are visible along the upper flank. These exhibit a high-contrast gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and a dark shadow-cast on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The remaining basal portion of the first dorsal fin contains approximately five to seven distinct high-luminance blobs, though the pattern is disrupted by structural loss of the fin's distal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Major structural trauma/amputation of the distal half of the first dorsal fin. A distinct yellow-pigmented linear growth or lesion is visible along the dorsal ridge between the first and second dorsal fins.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive occlusion of the ventral-anterior pectoral region by a high-density cluster of smaller teleost fish, likely exhibiting commensal behavior.
